title: Automotive Engineering: Turbocharging, EV Battery Thermal Management & Chassis Dynamics
description: Specialized automotive engineering module covering internal combustion turbocharging, electric vehicle battery liquid cooling, and suspension tuning.
learning_objectives: Master automotive engineering terminology (twin-scroll turbocharger, EV battery thermal management, regenerative braking, intercooler, anti-roll bars)
Apply cause-and-effect connectors and conditional rules to automotive diagnostics
Eliminate Czech interference errors when discussing vehicle performance, torque curves, and maintenance

questions.prompt: After aggressive highway driving, motorists _____ turbocharged engines idle for 60 seconds to circulate oil through hot turbo bearings.

explanations.correct: Modal 'should' is followed directly by the bare infinitive 'let' without 'to'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'should to let' is ungrammatical; modal verbs never take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po způsobovém slovesu 'should' následuje vždy základní tvar bez 'to': 'should let' (nikoli *should to let*).

questions.prompt: If the electric vehicle battery temperature _____ above 45 degrees Celsius, the liquid cooling chiller engages automatically.

explanations.correct: First conditional if-clause takes Present Simple ('rises') for automated thermal management rules.
explanations.wrong_A: Cannot use future modal 'will' inside an if-clause.
explanations.wrong_B: Cannot use 'would' in a real First Conditional.
explanations.wrong_D: Past tense 'rose' would conflict with present indicative 'engages'.

questions.cz_learning_point: V podmínkových větách po 'if' se nesmí použít 'will' (*If temperature will rise*). Použijte přítomný čas: 'If temperature rises'.

questions.prompt: During rapid cornering, anti-roll bars resist body lean by transferring torsional stiffness _____ the vehicle chassis.

explanations.correct: 'Across' appropriately describes forces distributed spanning from one side of the chassis to the other.
explanations.wrong_B: 'into of' is an invalid double preposition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'between of' is ungrammatical; 'between' does not take 'of'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předložka 'across' vyjadřuje přenos torzní tuhosti napříč podvozkem. Vyvarujte se chybné vazby *between of*.

questions.prompt: High-performance DOT 4 brake fluid _____ every two years because hygroscopic moisture absorption lowers its boiling point.

explanations.correct: Passive with modal 'must be replaced' correctly conveys vehicle maintenance requirements.
explanations.wrong_A: Active 'must replace' implies brake fluid replaces itself.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Trpný rod se způsobovým slovesem: 'must be replaced' (musí být vyměněna). Brzdová kapalina se sama nevyměňuje.

questions.prompt: The dynamometer technician _____ the electronic control unit (ECU) fuel mapping yesterday to eliminate a low-RPM flat spot.

explanations.correct: Specific completed past time indicator 'yesterday' strictly requires Past Simple 'remapped'.
explanations.wrong_A: Present Perfect 'has remapped' cannot accompany finished past time 'yesterday'.
explanations.wrong_B: Present Simple expresses habitual routines, not yesterday's finished event.
explanations.wrong_D: Present Continuous describes current actions, not yesterday's events.

questions.cz_learning_point: S příslovečným určením jako 'yesterday' se v angličtině striktně pojí minulý čas prostý (Past Simple: 'remapped'), nikoli předpřítomný čas.

questions.prompt: Engineers routed pressurized intake air through a front-mounted intercooler _____ compressed air density could be increased.

explanations.correct: 'So that' is a conjunction of purpose followed by a subject and modal verb clause ('air density could be increased').
explanations.wrong_C: 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase, not a clause with a finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Účelová spojka 'so that' = aby (následovaná podmětem a způsobovým slovesem: 'so that air density could be increased').

questions.prompt: A dual-clutch transmission pre-selects the next gear ratio so it can shift instantly without _____ engine torque.

explanations.correct: Preposition 'without' is followed by the '-ing' gerund form: 'cutting off'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'cutting off of' adds an unnecessary preposition.
explanations.wrong_C: Base form 'cut off' cannot follow preposition 'without'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách (jako 'without') následuje v angličtině sloveso s koncovkou -ing: 'without cutting off engine torque'.

questions.prompt: The sports sedan utilizes a multi-link rear suspension, _____ geometry maintains optimal tire contact patches under hard braking.

explanations.correct: Possessive relative pronoun 'whose' correctly links the antecedent 'suspension' with its attribute 'geometry'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'that' cannot be used in non-defining relative clauses set off by commas.

questions.cz_learning_point: Přivlastňovací vztažné zájmeno 'whose' (jehož geometrie) vyjadřuje přivlastňovací vztah i u technických mechanismů a podvozků.

questions.prompt: Given the sharp metallic whistle from the engine bay accompanied by black exhaust smoke, the turbocharger turbine wheel _____ damaged.

explanations.correct: 'Must be' expresses logical deduction based on audible and visual mechanical symptoms.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Logická dedukce (určitě je / musí být poškozeno): 'must be damaged'. Způsobová slovesa nepřibírají předložku 'to'.

questions.prompt: The vehicle cannot harness maximum regenerative braking efficiency _____ battery cell state-of-charge is below 90%.

explanations.correct: 'Unless' expresses 'except if' or 'if not', stating the physical battery prerequisite for regeneration.
explanations.wrong_A: 'if' produces an illogical statement (cannot harness IF below 90%).
explanations.wrong_C: 'provided that' creates an illogical positive condition.
explanations.wrong_D: 'as long as' also creates an illogical condition.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Unless' = pokud ne (if not). Po 'unless' už v angličtině nenásleduje další zápor: 'unless battery charge is below 90%'.
